<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <!-- Status bar -->

    <line x1="20" y1="103" x2="370" y2="103" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="63" y="339" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Alphabetical</text>

  <line x1="20" y1="361" x2="370" y2="361" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

    <polyline points="349,525 355,531 361,525" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Year chips -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="582" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Release year</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <g>

    <g>

      <text x="334" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
